findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "submit_student_protection_lead_request" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Submits the parent's contact information and assessment results so they can receive follow-up support. ONLY call this if the user explicitly consents to sharing…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "submit_student_protection_lead_request" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_student_protection_lead_request · Private data: submit_student_protection_lead_request · Public sink: submit_student_protection_lead_request · Destructive: run_student_safety_checklist, run_student_protection_readiness_assessment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_student_protection_lead_request · Private data: submit_student_protection_lead_request · Public sink: submit_student_protection_lead_request · Destructive: run_student_safety_checklist, run_student_protection_readiness_assessment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
